title: 지방보조금통합관리망의 관리 및 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 지방보조금통합관리망의 관리 및 운영에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 2 (Operating Standards) The Minister of the Interior and Safety shall ensure that the Integrated Local Subsidy Management System under Article 28 (1) of the Act on the Management of Local Government Subsidies (hereinafter referred to as the "Integrated Local Subsidy Management System") is operated for the execution and management of local subsidies and for storing and utilizing related materials and information.
